what: The flagged-case rule (every perf refinement must target the flagged LOOSE_CASE) collides with eval/prompts/perf_rules.txt:1 (measure only cells > 32 tiles, overrides everything) when the flagged case is the only cell and is <= 32 tiles (g6_untilize: 4 tiles, BB-22 forbids other shapes). The prompt never says what to do, so the 2:1 cadence and the flagged-case rule point one way and perf_rules the other.
suggest: State explicitly: if every flagged/measurable cell is <= the perf_rules tile threshold, file no perf refinement and record the perf position as a report finding.

what: The verify_supported CLI command fails with ImportError undefined symbol MPIX_Comm_shrink on chip-scoped slots: ttnn needs the LD_PRELOAD MPIX stub from .tt_chip_scope, which run_safe_pytest.sh and eval_test_runner.sh source but a bare python3 -m eval.verify_supported does not.
suggest: Prefix the documented command with [ -f .tt_chip_scope ] && source .tt_chip_scope, or have verify_supported avoid importing ttnn device libs.

what: The precision baseline asks for 3-4 shapes, but op specs carrying the model-wide BB-22 rule limit tests to production cases (one shape here). The conflict has to be resolved ad hoc; distributions were varied instead of shapes.
suggest: Add: when the op spec limits tests to production cases (BB-22), vary the input distribution over the production shape(s) instead of adding shapes.
